At Institute of Aesthetics in Scottsdale, Arizona, we specialize in natural-looking injectables, advanced laser skin treatments, regenerative aesthetics, and medical wellness services designed to help you look refreshed, feel confident, and age beautifully from the inside out.

Our Philosophy

At Institute of Aesthetics, our philosophy is rooted in the balance of advanced medical expertise, artistic precision, and highly individualized care. As a luxury boutique med spa and medical wellness center in Scottsdale, AZ, we take a thoughtful, medically guided approach to facial rejuvenation, skin health, laser treatments, regenerative aesthetics, and long-term aging support.

Our goal is never to change the way you look. Instead, we design personalized treatment plans that support facial harmony, natural-looking results, skin quality, and confidence through every stage of aging.

We believe aesthetic medicine should enhance your natural beauty — never erase what makes you uniquely you.

LEARN MORE

Our Providers

Our team of advanced aesthetic professionals works under the direct clinical leadership of founder Jennifer Prince, FNP-C, CANS. With decades of combined experience in skin health and injectable aesthetics, every provider brings specialized training, a commitment to safety, and a shared philosophy centered on precision and natural results.

The Institute of Aesthetics team includes Certified Aesthetic Nurse Specialists, Functional Medicine Practitioners, Licensed Medical Aestheticians, and Certified Laser Technologists — each an expert in their discipline, all aligned in their approach.

Our Founder

Jennifer Prince, FNP-C, CANS, is a nationally recognized aesthetic nurse practitioner with over 18 years of experience in plastic surgery, aesthetic medicine, and skin health. Known for her refined, medically guided approach, Jennifer specializes in creating natural, balanced results that enhance each patient’s unique features rather than change them.

As the founder of Institute of Aesthetics, she blends advanced clinical expertise with an artistic eye to develop individualized treatment plans focused on long-term skin health, facial harmony, and graceful aging. Her philosophy centers on thoughtful, conservative care — helping patients look refreshed, confident, and unmistakably themselves.

In addition to leading her Scottsdale practice, Jennifer contributes to the advancement of the aesthetics industry through advanced professional education, mentorship, and online training designed for experienced providers seeking elevated clinical insight.

MORE ABOUT US
Our Services

Injectables & Facial Rejuvenation

Neuromodulators, dermal fillers, and facial balancing treatments designed for natural, harmonious results.

LEARN MORE

At Institute of Aesthetics in Scottsdale, AZ, our injectable treatments are designed to create natural, balanced facial rejuvenation with a medically guided approach. We offer Botox and Dysport neuromodulators, dermal fillers, Sculptra, and personalized facial balancing treatments to soften signs of aging, restore volume, improve facial harmony, and help you look refreshed — never overdone.
Each injectable treatment is customized by our experienced aesthetic medical team under the clinical leadership of Jennifer Prince, FNP-C, CANS, with a focus on safety, anatomy, precision, and long-term aesthetic planning.

Laser & Skin Treatments

Advanced laser, microneedling, and skin therapies targeting texture, tone, pigmentation, and overall skin health.

LEARN MORE

Regenerative Aesthetics

PRP, PRF, bio filler, and exosome treatments that work with your body to restore and maintain youthful, radiant skin.

LEARN MORE

 Medical Wellness

Medical weight loss, hormone optimization, and regenerative cellular therapies to support how you look and how you feel.

LEARN MORE

What Our Patients Are Saying

There is so much goodness to be said about iA as both a provider of aesthetic services and a training center! Jennifer Prince and the team at iA do everything with excellence. All of the injectors take their time with each patient and have a true depth of knowledge about facial anatomy to achieve the safe, beautiful results.

Allison O .

Jennifer came highly recommended to me and I was excited to give her a try. Multiple friends and clients spoke highly of her, so about a year ago I made my first appointment.  To say I have been impressed and continue to be, is an understatement. I am extremely particular about my skin, and who I let touch it-being in the industry myself-I have annoyingly high standards. In the last twelve years of getting Botox consistently every 3-4 months, I haves always bruised after. I’m very vascular and I just figured that was my “normal”. Jennifer is the first injector that has EVER not bruised me. Her precision, patience and extensive knowledge of facial anatomy was what made me so comfortable from the point of meeting her to current day. I found my forever injector.

Mackenzie B.

I’ve spent years and thousands of dollars trying to correct my acne scarring. I was seeing Jennifer for Botox when she recommended Sculptra to me. I was hesitant at first as nothing had worked for me in the past but trusted her and her professional input. I’ve had 3 injections so far and am so happy with the results! Jennifer is not only the sweetest person but a miracle worker as well! I highly recommend this beautiful woman for all your esthetic/injection needs!

Victoria D.

I have been going to Jenn for 3 years now and there aren't enough words to describe how amazing she is. I was so scared to do Botox or fillers...it's my face! But when I met Jenn, I instantly trusted her 110%. She is honest and is not in the business to take your money. Beyond that, she is extremely talented and you can tell that she is so passionate about her career. I recommend her to women on a daily basis! Her office is beautiful and her team is just as fabulous as she is. Thank you, Institute of Aesthetics & Jenn!

Madison S.
